name: Way 2 Vat Ltd
summary: Way 2 Vat Ltd is a financial technology company providing global solutions for recovering and submitting Value Added Tax and Goods and Services Tax. It operates an automated platform for VAT refunds, helping businesses with international and domestic VAT recovery, including foreign VAT claims on accounts payable invoices, and with VAT compliance. Founded in 2014, it operates mainly from Tel Aviv, Israel.
